  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.

The car is equipped with silver-finished Ferrari-branded brake calipers and 19-inch 5-spoke alloy wheels with Ferrari center caps, supported by four-wheel disc braking. A dual twin-exit stainless steel exhaust system completes the mechanical package at the rear.

The car is also accompanied by its owner's manual, service book, tire inflator kit with storage bag, and copies of $17,222.50 in receipt copies, along with a clean CARFAX report.

A notable point of interest is that the F430's F136 engine family was jointly developed by Ferrari and Maserati during this era, and it is widely regarded as one of the most reliable and responsive naturally aspirated V8 platforms Ferrari produced before turbocharging became standard in later models. It also marked Ferrari's early integration of Formula 1-derived electronic shift logic into a road car, bridging track technology with street usability.

description: 1994 Mustang Engine Information – 302 cubic inch V-8 (5.0 L H.O V8) The “5.0L High Output” Ford Small Block V8 The 302 cubic inch engine was introduced in 1968 to the Mustang. '94 Ford Mustang GTFord celebrated the 30th anniversary of "America's favorite ponycar" in 1994 with the release of an all-new Mustang. The '94 Mustang had a lot to live up to, it had to be better than the six million Mustangs built before it, while carrying on the styling cues and performance flavor that have spawned a nation of Mustang lovers. With a limited budget of $700 million (a pittance compared with the $6 billion allocated for the Ford Contour and Mercury Mystique), engineers built the new car on an improved version of the code-named Fox chassis used for the '79-93 Mustang. A familiar powerplant, the ever-popular 5.0-liter V-8, was put to work in the GT version, allowing a comfortable transition to the new car for enthusiasts and tuners alike. Ford's accomplishments with the striking new Mustang won our favor immediately, earning it the honor of Motor Trend's 1994 Car of the Year. After our initial tests, we added a GT to our long-term test fleet for the first-hand experience of living with the latest ponycar to wear the galloping-horse medallion. The GT coupe began with a sticker of $17,280, which we optioned up to $20,510, including destination and delivery. Our street champ was ordered in Vibrant Red with a black cloth interior, just the way we remember seeing the original '6411/42 Mustang when it turned heads 30 years previous. Option Group #2, at $1855, included cruise control, air conditioning, and anti-lock brakes. An additional $310 for Group #3 brought remote keyless entry, a cargo tie-down net, and illuminated entry. Next, we ordered the powerful Mach 460 AM/FM/cassette stereo at $375, with another $475 for an accompanying CD player. 2014 Jaguar F-TYPE V8 S Convertible 2D The Soul of a Supercar with a Masterpiece SoundtrackThe 2014 Jaguar F-TYPE V8 S is a raw, visceral, and unapologetic celebration of performance. As the flagship model for the F-TYPE's debut year, it was designed to reignite Jaguar s legendary sports car heritage. Combining a stunning, award-winning silhouette with a thunderous V8 engine, it is the perfect choice for the driver who wants a car that is as much an emotional experience as it is a high-speed machine.Under the hood, the V8 S is powered by a ferocious 5.0-liter Supercharged V8 engine, producing a massive 495 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque. This power is sent exclusively to the rear wheels via a lightning-fast 8-speed Quickshift automatic transmission. This combination allows the F-TYPE to rocket from 0 to 60 mph in a blistering 4.2 seconds. The active sport exhaust system is world-renowned for its signature crackles and pops, delivering an intoxicating roar that makes every tunnel an opportunity for a symphony.The driving experience is sharp, communicative, and thrilling. Built on a rigid, lightweight aluminum chassis, the V8 S features an Electronic Active Differential that constantly manages torque between the rear wheels to maximize traction and cornering speed. The Adaptive Dynamics suspension monitors driver input and road conditions up to 500 times per second, adjusting the dampers to keep the car perfectly balanced during spirited mountain drives or high-speed highway cruising.On the exterior, the 2014 F-TYPE is a masterclass in modern design, featuring:
  • A sleek, muscular stance with a long hood and a short rear deck
  • Iconic quad outboard exhaust tips that distinguish the V8 model from the V6
  • Hidden deployable door handles that retract for a smooth aerodynamic profile
  • An active rear spoiler that rises at 60 mph to increase downforce by up to 264 lbs
Inside, the cabin is a focused, driver-centric cockpit that blends luxury with high-performance intent. It features Performance seats with heavy bolsters to keep you secure during high-G maneuvers. The interior is finished in premium leather with contrast stitching and features the unique Ignis orange start button and paddle shifters. The center air vents even rise out of the dash only when needed, maintaining a clean and uncluttered aesthetic.Practicality is prioritized for the grand touring experience. The convertible top is a lightweight fabric roof that can be raised or lowered in just 12 seconds at speeds of up to 30 mph, allowing you to react to changing weather instantly. While the trunk is compact, it is designed to fit a set of golf clubs or a pair of weekend overnight bags, making it the ultimate vehicle for a stylish coastal getaway.Fuel economy is managed by an Intelligent Stop/Start system, achieving approximately 16 MPG city/23 MPG highway. While the F-TYPE is capable of refined cruising, its heart is in the Dynamic Mode, which firms up the steering, sharpens the throttle response, and opens the exhaust valves for maximum engagement.Safety is world-class, featuring a roll-over protection system, high-performance Jaguar Super Performance brakes with black calipers, and a suite of stability controls designed to keep the massive V8 power in check. The 2014 model also includes a 380-watt Meridian Sound System, ensuring that when you aren't listening to the engine, you are enjoying concert-quality audio.The 2014 Jaguar F-TYPE V8 S Convertible is a modern classic. It is the ideal choice for the driver who wants a bold, beautiful, and loud British sports car that offers a level of character and theater that few other vehicles can match.Beautiful. Ferocious. Unforgettable. ??
